Exec [dbo].[sp_ins_ssis_utility_alert]
  @TO = 'wfsrs@wellsfargo.com'
 ,@SUBJECT = 'WFSR&S_ProcessAlert_DEV_Collateral_Margin_Disputes_ETL_WARNING' 
 ,@BODY = 'Collateral Margin Disputes data failed to load'
 ,@BodyFormat = '2'

SELECT COUNT(1) AS NumRows FROM dbo.tbl_Collateral_Margin_Disputes_KRI_Disputes
WHERE loadDate>= CAST(GetDate() as Date)

--Margin Agreed Data Set
	WITH MarginAgreed_Numerator 
	AS
		(
		--Numerator
		  SELECT CAST(A.eventDate as Date) as eventDate
		  ,SUM(ABS(CAST(A.disputeValueUSD as decimal(18,2)))) as disputeValueUSD
		  FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Collateral_Margin_Disputes_KRI_Disputes] A
		  INNER JOIN 
				(SELECT distinct CAST(eventDate as Date) as eventDate, counterparty, disputeValueUSD
				FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Collateral_Margin_Disputes_KRI_Disputes]) B
			ON CAST(A.eventDate as Date) = B.eventDate
			AND A.counterparty = B.counterparty
			AND A.disputeValueUSD = B.disputeValueUSD
		  WHERE disputeType = 'Demand'
		  GROUP BY CAST(A.eventDate as Date)
		),


		MarginAgreed_Demominator 
		AS
		(
			--Denominator
			SELECT CAST(A.eventDate as Date) as eventDate
			,SUM(CAST(A.rptCallAmount as decimal(18,2))) as rptCallAmount
			FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Collateral_Margin_Disputes_KRI_DailyExposure] A
			Where Action in ('Call','Call(Deficit)','IM Call','IM Recall','Recall','VM Call','VM Recall')
			AND callStatus not in ('Waived', 'Pending Review')
			GROUP BY CAST(A.eventDate as Date)
		)

	--Insert into Margin Agreed Data set
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[tbl_Collateral_Margin_Agreed_Details]
		(
			eventDate,
			disputeValueUSD,
			rptCallAmount,
			[totalMarginAgreed], 
			[disputePercentage], 
			[marginAgreedPercentage] 
		)
		SELECT N.eventDate,
			   N.disputeValueUSD,
			   D.rptCallAmount, 
			   D.rptCallAmount - N.disputeValueUSD,
			   (N.disputeValueUSD/D.rptCallAmount) * 100,
			   (D.rptCallAmount - N.disputeValueUSD)/D.rptCallAmount
		FROM MarginAgreed_Numerator N
		INNER JOIN MarginAgreed_Demominator D ON N.eventDate = D.eventDate
		WHERE N.eventDate NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT eventDate
			 FROM [dbo].[tbl_Collateral_Margin_Agreed_Details]
			);
			
	
	--Collateral Disputes Data Set
	With CollateralDisputes_MainSet 
	AS
		(
		SELECT CAST(eventDate as Date) as eventDate, 
			counterparty, directionalDisputeAge
		  FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Collateral_Margin_Disputes_KRI_Disputes] 
		),

		CollateralDisputes_Numerator
		AS
		(
			--Numerator
			SELECT
			  DATEPART(week, eventDate) AS weekId,
			  Max(eventDate) AS eventDate,
			  count(Distinct counterparty) AS counterparty8Count
			FROM CollateralDisputes_MainSet
			WHERE directionalDisputeAge > 8 
			GROUP BY DATEPART(week, eventDate)
		),

		CollateralDisputes_Demominator 
		AS
		(
		--Denominator
		SELECT
			  DATEPART(week, eventDate) AS weekId,
			  Max(eventDate) AS eventDate,
			  count(Distinct counterparty) AS counterpartyTotalCount
			FROM CollateralDisputes_MainSet
			GROUP BY DATEPART(week, eventDate)

		)

		--Insert into Collateral Dispute Data set
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[tbl_Collateral_Disputes_Details]
		(
			
			eventDate,
			weekId,
			counterparty8Count, 
			counterpartyTotalCount
		)
		SELECT N.eventDate,
			   N.weekId,
			   N.Counterparty8Count,
			   D.CounterpartyTotalCount
		FROM CollateralDisputes_Numerator N
		INNER JOIN CollateralDisputes_Demominator D ON N.eventDate = D.eventDate
		WHERE N.eventDate NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT eventDate
			 FROM [dbo].[tbl_Collateral_Disputes_Details]
			)

--Margin Agreed_Numerator Data Set

--Margin Agreed Data Set
	WITH MarginAgreed_Numerator 
	AS
		(
		--Numerator
		  SELECT CAST(A.eventDate as Date) as eventDate
		  ,SUM(ABS(CAST(A.disputeSpreadUSD as decimal(18,2)))) as disputeSpreadUSD
		  FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].tbl_Collateral_Margin_CallDispute_Numerator_Details A
		  INNER JOIN 
				(SELECT distinct CAST(eventDate as Date) as eventDate, counterparty, disputeSpreadUSD
				FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].tbl_Collateral_Margin_CallDispute_Numerator_Details) B
			ON CAST(A.eventDate as Date) = B.eventDate
			AND A.counterparty = B.counterparty
			AND A.disputeSpreadUSD = B.disputeSpreadUSD
		    GROUP BY CAST(A.eventDate as Date)
		),


		MarginAgreed_Demominator 
		AS
		(
			--Denominator 
			SELECT CAST(eventDate as Date) as eventDate
			,SUM(CAST(rptCallAmount as decimal(18,2))) as rptCallAmount
			FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].tbl_Collateral_Margin_CallVolumeDemand_Details
			Where marginCallType = 'MarginCallVolume_Demand'
			GROUP BY CAST(eventDate as Date)
		),


		MarginCallVolume
		AS
		(
			SELECT CAST(eventDate as Date) as eventDate
			,count(*) as MarginCallVolume
			FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].tbl_Collateral_Margin_CallVolumeDemand_Details
			GROUP BY CAST(eventDate as Date)
		),



		MarginCallVolume_Settled
		AS
		(
			SELECT CAST(creationDate as Date) as creationDate
			,count(*) as MarginCallVolume_Settled
			FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].tbl_Collateral_Margin_CallVolumeDemand_Settled_Details
			GROUP BY CAST(creationDate as Date)
		)


	--Insert into Margin Agreed Data set
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[tbl_Collateral_Margin_CallVolumeDispute_Daily]
		(
			eventDate,
			rptCallAmount,
			disputeValueUSD,
			marginCallVolume,
			marginCallDisputeNumerator,
			marginCallDisputeDenominator
		)
		SELECT N.eventDate,
			   D.rptCallAmount, 
			   N.disputeSpreadUSD,
			   VD.MarginCallVolume + DS.MarginCallVolume_Settled,
			   N.disputeSpreadUSD,
			   D.rptCallAmount
		FROM MarginAgreed_Numerator N
		INNER JOIN MarginAgreed_Demominator D ON N.eventDate = D.eventDate
		INNER JOIN MarginCallVolume VD ON N.eventDate = VD.eventDate
		INNER JOIN MarginCallVolume_Settled DS ON N.eventDate = DS.creationDate

		WHERE N.eventDate NOT IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT eventDate
			 FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Collateral_Margin_CallVolumeDispute_Daily]
			 WHERE eventDate >= GETDATE() - 7
			);

		UPDATE a
		SET a.loadDate = b.loadDate
		FROM [ReconControl].[dbo].[tbl_Collateral_Margin_CallVolumeDispute_Daily] a
			Left outer join [ReconControl].[dbo].tbl_Collateral_Margin_CallVolumeDemand_Details b on a.eventDate = b.eventDate
		WHERE a.loadDate IS NULL;
